===

'멈추지 마, 다시 꿈부터 써봐', '꿈을 요리하는 마법카페', '온 우주가 너를 사랑해', '마음스파', '당신의 꿈은 무엇입니까', '당신의 사랑은 무엇입니까'의 저자 김수영입니다. https://bit.ly/2Jun2gl

김수영스쿨 온라인 수업
https://educast.com/channel/1622/courses

1. 인생내공 실전수업 
1) 진짜 꿈을 찾고 이루는 법 
2) 경제적 시간적 자유를 얻는 법 
3) 나를 사랑하고 너를 사랑하는 법 
4) 인간관계와 멘탈관리

3) 강연가의 모든 것 - 부업에서 억대연봉까지 내 이야기로 돈 버는 직업

en-US.title: Kim Soo-young TV ♥ 'The Magic Cafe That Cooks Dreams' Animation Trailer
en-US.description:
This is the animated version of my first children's book, #TheMagicCafeThatCooksDreams, created after it was selected for the 2019 Korea Content Creative Agency (KOCCA) Scalability Animation Support Project. 'Scalability animation' refers to the combination of animation with live-action footage. Under the given budget and conditions, I produced a video just over 8 minutes long that includes live-action footage of two dishes being cooked. Following the 1-minute teaser released last time, today I will release a 5-minute pure animation video excluding the cooking scenes, and next time, I will release the scalability animation video that includes the cooking scenes. Unfortunately, due to limitations in budget and production time, this video only covers the introduction and not the entire story, so please check the book if you are curious about the full story! https://bit.ly/2Jun2gl
